questions.question: Trait vs struct?
options: Struct holds data; trait promises behavior any struct can keep
questions.explanation: Data vs capability: promises compose across types.

questions.question: announce(&42_i32) fails because?
options: i32 keeps no Describe promise (bound unsatisfied)
questions.explanation: Bounds gate calls at compile time, naming the gap.

questions.question: Monomorphization means?
options: Compiler stamps per-type copies (no runtime cost, bigger binary)
questions.explanation: Pay in bytes, not cycles — visible via nm.

questions.question: Box<Pcb> does what to p?
options: Moves to heap; p dead after
questions.explanation: Move rule: ownership relocates, old name dies.

questions.question: Display impl buys?
questions.explanation: Formatting is a trait: keep it, unlock the ecosystem.

questions.question: Bound removal breaks announce body because?
options: Without bound the generic can't know .describe exists
questions.explanation: Bounds carry method knowledge into generic bodies.
